definition:
flowchart LR
  Start([Request]) --> Auth[Authenticate]
  Auth --> Cache{Cache hit?}
  Cache -->|hit| Serve[Serve cached]
  Cache -->|miss| Fetch[Fetch from origin]
  Fetch --> Store[(Write cache)]
  Store --> Serve
  Serve --> Done([Response])
  classDef pale fill:#fafafa,stroke:#e0e0e0,stroke-width:1px,color:#333333
  class Start,Auth,Cache,Serve,Fetch,Store,Done pale
  linkStyle default stroke:#cccccc,stroke-width:1px
intent: HARDCODED LIGHT PALETTE that must survive DARK theme: near-white fills #fafafa, pale grey strokes #e0e0e0, #333333 text, #cccccc edge strokes. In light theme these are all fine-to-marginal; in dark theme the #fafafa islands should punch out of the dark canvas while #333 text on #fafafa stays readable - the real question is the #e0e0e0/#cccccc strokes, which must hold 3:1 against BOTH canvases. Every color is written in the spec so every ratio is computable. Paired with w3-10 (mirror) and w3-15 (no colors) on the SAME graph so the three are directly comparable.
